binding_note: Runner normalizes the accepted legacy score.metrics into this experiment-owned contract; resource and execution admission remain separate.
contract_name: E164 experiment-owned logical score report input proposal

prefix_item.C: The original C score.metrics object directly, with no wrapper added
prefix_item.C_reference: Non-empty accurate source identity metadata for the original C metrics

V.reference: Non-empty accurate provenance metadata; retain the source identity unchanged

prefix_item.seed: integer; must equal its position in prefix_seed_order

identity_checks.W0_baseline: For each prefix, C, V, UG, and UR W0_fresh old/new train/holdout values must all match exactly; each G_new uses the same-split W0_fresh new value as baseline
identity_checks.prepared_id: C, V, UG, and UR each contain the same non-empty prepared_id

score_metrics.numeric_policy: Finite JSON integers/floats only; reject booleans, NaN, and infinities

required_common_fields.prepared_id: non-empty string; C, V, UG, and UR identities must match per prefix

classification.G_new: higher is improvement; lower is degradation
classification.old_kl: lower is improvement; higher is degradation

report.paired_delta: right arm minus left arm; include signed and absolute difference per prefix
report.prepared_identity: Repeat the shared non-empty prepared_id on each paired row
prohibited: treating multiple probes, labels, packages, or closures as independent samples
report.reported_G_new: For each of pre_codec_fresh and encoded_fresh, W0_fresh.new_split - that view's new_split, for train and holdout; encoded_fresh holdout must exactly match legacy G_new
report.reported_old_kl: Only pre_codec_fresh and encoded_fresh, each for train and holdout
report.summary: Finite counts of improved, degraded, and unchanged logical prefixes for every fixed metric/view/split

verification.current_verifier_result: Must remain INCOMPLETE; must not emit COMPLETE_VALID.
verification.mirror_files: verify_results requires an explicit caller-supplied allowlisted root; hash only explicitly listed source/mirror regular files, resolve both paths and reject any resolved path outside that root. Do not scan directories or take the root from receipt data.
verification.report_recalculation: Independent finite-metric and paired-delta recomputation may be provided without importing report.py.
verification.scientific_trace_probe_alias_records: PENDING_SOURCE_FREEZE; raw record schemas and bindings are not yet frozen.
verification.source_and_input_binding: PENDING_SOURCE_FREEZE; exact runner/manifest binding fields are not yet frozen.
verification.worker_and_meter_records: PENDING_SOURCE_FREEZE; require the finalized runner workerstate/meter schema before completeness can be verified.
